SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.inherit_role_id, r.status, r.is_builtin, r.perm_version, r.sort, r.created_at, r.updated_at, p.name AS inherit_role_name FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role p ON p.id = r.inherit_role_id
ORDER BY r.sort, r.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, code, name, sort FROM sys_role WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT id, code, name, description, inherit_role_id, status, is_builtin, perm_version, sort FROM sys_role WHERE status <> 2 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM sys_role ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.inherit_role_id, r.status, r.is_builtin, r.perm_version, r.sort, r.created_at, r.updated_at, p.name AS inherit_role_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.id) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id) AS permission_count FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role p ON p.id = r.inherit_role_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.status <> 2
SELECT id, code, name, description, inherit_role_id, status, is_builtin, perm_version, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 2 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, code, name, description, inherit_role_id, status, is_builtin, perm_version, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (code, name, description, inherit_role_id, status, is_builtin, perm_version, sort, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{inheritRoleId}, #{status}, #{isBuiltin}, #{permVersion}, #{sort}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort = #{sort}, inherit_role_id = #{inheritRoleId}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 2
